scope_notes: Per-tool projection map: filesystem paths each AI coding tool reads, by kind, at project and user scope. csaw projects for Claude Code and Codex only (scope decision 2026-09-28); every other tool here is research kept for reference and marked csaw_in_code: false. This file documents what tools READ. What csaw WRITES is decided by the Go ToolRegistry in internal/mount/tools.go and rendered into tool-projection.md by cmd/tools-gen; a test asserts every directory csaw reads or writes for a supported tool is documented here. Per-tool checked_at records when the research was last verified.

confidence_legend.verified: Read directly from official tool docs.
confidence_legend.documented: Official docs mention but with caveats.
confidence_legend.unsupported: Tool does not have a documented file-based concept for this kind.

path_conventions.globs: * matches a filename segment; ** matches any number of segments; <name> is a placeholder.

kinds_definitions.instructions: Always-on project guidance. AGENTS.md is the cross-tool file; CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .hermes.md, .goosehints are tool-specific. [csaw projects: YES; generates CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md bridges that import AGENTS.md when the registry has none]
kinds_definitions.agents: Subagent / persona / mode definitions. [csaw projects: YES]
kinds_definitions.skills: On-demand procedural workflows: SKILL.md folders including their references/, scripts/, and assets/ (Agent Skills standard). [csaw projects: YES, whole directory]
kinds_definitions.mcp: MCP server configs. Per-tool schema varies widely. [csaw projects: YES (via per-tool registry files)]
kinds_definitions.hooks: Lifecycle handlers triggered by tool events. A registry hooks/hooks.json (Claude Code / Codex shape) is merged into each tool's hooks file (.claude/settings.local.json, .codex/hooks.json) as csaw-owned matcher groups; scripts under hooks/scripts/ are copied beside them and commands rewritten. [csaw projects: YES]
kinds_definitions.ignore: Context exclusion patterns (.cody/ignore, .cursorignore, .tongyiignore). [csaw projects: YES — planned v0.6.0]
kinds_definitions.memory: Persistent context across sessions. [csaw projects: NEVER for now — most memory is session state or user-private. Revisit if a portable memory standard emerges.]
kinds_definitions.settings: General tool config that may contain multiple kinds. [csaw projects: NEVER — settings files contain API keys and personal credentials; mounting them to a team source would leak secrets. Documented as reference only.]

claude.scope_notes: Anthropic's official CLI. Originator of .claude/agents/ and SKILL.md folder patterns (now agentskills.io open standard).

instructions.notes: Does NOT read AGENTS.md; docs recommend a CLAUDE.md that imports it (@AGENTS.md) or a symlink. csaw generates that CLAUDE.md bridge when a registry has none. CLAUDE.local.md is gitignored personal additions. Managed policy CLAUDE.md under /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/ or /etc/claude-code/.

rules.notes: A symlink whose target is outside the working directory is treated as an external import: it does not load until external imports are approved, and path-scoped rules never load through it. Motivates csaw copy mode.
rules.file_pattern: *.md (recursive); optional paths: frontmatter for path-scoped rules

agents.notes: Identity from `name` not path. Precedence: enterprise > user > project > plugin.

skills.notes: Folder-per-skill (Agent Skills standard); symlinked skill folders are read. Does not read .agents/skills. Legacy .claude/commands/ still works.

mcp.notes: OAuth via /mcp command. MCP_TIMEOUT env var.

hooks.notes: Hooks are declared in settings JSON (user, project, local, managed), plugin hooks/hooks.json, or skill/agent frontmatter; entries merge across levels. No hooks directory is scanned. csaw merges owned matcher groups into .claude/settings.local.json and copies scripts to .claude/hooks/scripts/, rewriting commands to ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}.

memory.notes: Per-subagent persistent memory. -local variant is gitignored.

codex.scope_notes: TOML-driven config. Skills follow the Agent Skills standard under the neutral .agents/skills; docs moved from developers.openai.com to learn.chatgpt.com.

skills.notes: Scanned from cwd up to the repo root. .codex/skills is no longer documented. Optional agents/openai.yaml sidecar per skill.

mcp.notes: MCP ONLY in config.toml. Closest .codex/config.toml wins.

hooks.notes: Same JSON shape as Claude Code hooks; 12 events (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PermissionRequest, PreCompact, PostCompact, UserPromptSubmit, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, Stop, SessionStart, SessionEnd, Interrupt); handler types command and mcp_tool. Commands run in the session cwd; docs recommend resolving from the git root. Non-managed hooks are trusted by hash and re-reviewed when they change. csaw merges owned groups into .codex/hooks.json and copies scripts to .codex/hooks/scripts/.

ignore.notes: Respects .gitignore. project_doc_max_bytes/project_doc_fallback_filenames in config.toml control AGENTS.md discovery.

settings.notes: Single config.toml holds agents, MCP, hooks.

cursor.scope_notes: Not projected by csaw (Claude Code and Codex only, since 2026-09-28). Cursor CLI (Jan 2026) shares config with desktop.

rules.file_pattern: *.mdc only; a plain .md in .cursor/rules is ignored because it has no frontmatter
rules.notes: Frontmatter: alwaysApply, globs, description. AGENTS.md (root and nested) is the plain-markdown alternative. Team Rules from the dashboard apply first.

agents.notes: Markdown with frontmatter (name, description, model, readonly, is_background). .cursor/ wins on name conflicts.

skills.notes: Agent Skills standard; nested skill directories supported. .cursor/commands/ single-file commands still exist.

auth_types: OAuth static client credentials in `auth` object
mcp.notes: Trae also reads ~/.cursor/mcp.json as user-global fallback.

opencode.scope_notes: Not projected by csaw (Claude Code and Codex only, since 2026-09-28). OSS leader (150K+ stars). EXPLICIT cross-tool compat — reads .claude/ and .agents/ as skill fallbacks.

agents.notes: Filename = agent name. mode: subagent | primary.

skills.notes: SIX paths. csaw projects .claude/skills/ and .agents/skills/ → free OpenCode coverage.

hooks.notes: Plugin events / hook adapter via ECC. Native story unclear.

settings.notes: Single config holds MCP, agent config, models.

windsurf.scope_notes: Not projected by csaw (Claude Code and Codex only, since 2026-09-28). Renamed Devin Desktop on 2026-06-02 (OTA). Preferred paths moved under .devin/; .windsurf/rules and .windsurfrules still read. A separate Devin CLI reads AGENTS.md, AGENTS.local.md, .devin/config.json. Not in ToolRegistry; AGENTS.md and .agents/skills cover it.

env_var_substitution: variable interpolation in command, args, env, serverUrl, url, headers
mcp.notes: User-scope ONLY. 100 total tools limit across all MCP servers.

memory.notes: Cascade memories — manage via 'Manage memories' UI.

copilot.scope_notes: Not projected by csaw (Claude Code and Codex only, since 2026-09-28). VS Code Copilot and Copilot CLI share the same .github/ paths and ~/.copilot/ user-scope agents. csaw projects rules (with .instructions.md suffix) and agents (with .agent.md suffix) into .github/. Projected files are hidden from git by default like every other projection — teams who want them committed for PR review run `csaw show .github/instructions/*` as an explicit opt-in. Skills (.github/prompts/, single-file) and the .github/copilot-instructions.md alias not yet projected — AGENTS.md at project root covers Copilot's universal-instructions case.

agents.notes: .agent.md suffix under .github/agents (nested dirs discovered); .claude/agents read for compatibility. Shares ~/.copilot/agents/ with Copilot CLI.

skills.notes: Agent Skills across cloud agent, code review, CLI, VS Code, JetBrains. .github/prompts/ single-file prompts deprecated in favour of skills.

mcp.sandboxing: macOS/Linux stdio: sandboxEnabled + sandbox object for fs/network
mcp.notes: VS Code reads .vscode/mcp.json (top-level `servers`). Copilot CLI reads .mcp.json and .github/mcp.json (mcpServers) plus ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json.

hooks.notes: One JSON file per hook set; 8 events.

settings.notes: VS Code workspace settings (Copilot-related keys nested).

gemini.scope_notes: Not projected by csaw (Claude Code and Codex only, since 2026-09-28). Consumer (free / AI Pro / Ultra) auth ended 2026-06-18 and moved to Antigravity CLI; API-key and Gemini Code Assist enterprise users continue and the OSS project keeps releasing (v0.59.0 on 2026-09-08). Removed from ToolRegistry in v0.6.0 on a misread of that announcement; reinstated in v0.11.0.

instructions.notes: Loaded from ancestors and just-in-time from subdirectories; @file imports supported; context.fileName can add AGENTS.md. csaw generates a GEMINI.md bridge importing AGENTS.md when the registry has none.

skills.notes: Agent Skills standard; the .agents alias wins when both exist.

extensions.notes: Extensions bundle skills/, agents/, hooks/hooks.json, commands/, policies/.

antigravity.scope_notes: Not projected by csaw (Claude Code and Codex only, since 2026-09-28). Google's agentic CLI + IDE. Successor for Gemini CLI consumer accounts (Gemini CLI itself continues for API-key and enterprise users). Uses the neutral .agents/ layout: rules, agents, skills.

rules.notes: Rules directory under .agents/; legacy .agent/rules still read.

agents.notes: Folder of markdown subagent definitions (earlier docs described a single agents.md file; now a directory).

skills.file_pattern: folder containing SKILL.md AND/OR skills.md declaration

mcp.notes: Settings holds colorScheme, model, trustedWorkspaces. MCP schema likely inherits Gemini CLI.

hooks.notes: Hooks supported (inherited from Gemini CLI); paths unclear.

memory.notes: Antigravity 2.0 uses ~/.gemini/antigravity/ for brain entries, scratch space.

kiro.scope_notes: Not projected by csaw (Claude Code and Codex only, since 2026-09-28). AWS agentic coding IDE on Bedrock. Spec-driven. Removed from ToolRegistry in v0.6.1 to keep projection focused; re-add on user demand.

skills.notes: Kiro 'specs' (Requirements/Design/Tasks in EARS notation) — different from Claude skills semantically.

mcp.notes: MCP supported but exact paths not in fetched docs.

hooks.notes: Triggers on file events, prompt/agent lifecycle, spec task events, manual.

continue.scope_notes: Not projected by csaw (Claude Code and Codex only, since 2026-09-28). Has .continue/rules/ (project) and ~/.continue/rules/ (user) — file-based, NOT all nested in config.

rules.notes: Hub-based rules via `uses:` in config.yaml. Use 01-, 02- prefixes for order.

mcp.notes: Nested in config — not file-projectable separately.

cline.scope_notes: Not projected by csaw (Claude Code and Codex only, since 2026-09-28). Formerly Claude Dev. VS Code + JetBrains + CLI. Roo Code is popular fork.

instructions.notes: .clinerules can be file or directory. Workspace > global.

skills.notes: Skills feature mentioned but file convention unclear.

mcp.notes: Managed in Cline IDE settings panel.

goose.scope_notes: Not projected by csaw (Claude Code and Codex only, since 2026-09-28). MOVED from block/goose to aaif-goose/goose. .goosehints + .goose/recipes/ are real file-based concepts.

instructions.notes: Subdirectory walk combines hints up to repo root. Respects .gitignore.

agents.notes: Markdown agent definitions under the neutral .agents/agents; .goose/agents and .claude/agents read for compatibility.

skills.notes: Agent Skills canonical under .agents/skills since v1.30; .goose/skills and .claude/skills read for compatibility. Recipes (.goose/recipes/, YAML) are a separate concept.

mcp.notes: Goose extensions = MCP servers. 70+ extensions. Configured via `goose configure`.

watchlist.description: Tools with file-based projection that are less prioritized for csaw's MVP. Promoted to deep entries when adoption signals warrant.

roo-code.scope_notes: Repository archived 2026-05-15. The Kilo Code fork continues (.kilocode/rules, AGENTS.md).

codebuddy.scope_notes: Cleanest Claude-like structure. Removed from ToolRegistry in v0.6.1 — China-focused; re-add on user demand.

kilo-code.scope_notes: Reads .claude/ and .agents/ — csaw's projection serves Kilo for free.

aider.scope_notes: No release since v0.86.0 (2025-08-09). Reads CONVENTIONS.md; csaw still projects .aiderignore through the ignore kind.

amazon-q.scope_notes: Clean .amazonq/rules/ with subdir support. Removed from ToolRegistry in v0.6.1 to keep projection focused; re-add on user demand.

openhands.scope_notes: .openhands/microagents/ — V0 'microagents', V1 'skills'. Same path. Removed from ToolRegistry in v0.6.1 to keep projection focused; re-add on user demand.

zed.scope_notes: Reads .rules at project root. MCP via settings.json context_servers (user-scope).

hermes.scope_notes: CROSS-TOOL READER. Already served by csaw projecting AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and .cursor/rules/ — Hermes reads all of those. Adding explicit .hermes.md/HERMES.md projection would require a dedicated entry but is not necessary for csaw to be useful to Hermes users today.

claw-code.scope_notes: Clean-room rewrite of Claude Code. Reuses .claude/ — csaw projection serves automatically.

plandex.scope_notes: Plan-first CLI. Dotfile conventions less standardized.

devin-cli.scope_notes: Companion CLI to Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf). Reads AGENTS.md, AGENTS.local.md, .claude/, .cursor/rules; project config in .devin/.

additional_tools_known_to_exist_not_rese.description: Tools from various catalogues not deep-researched. Most lack documented or significant filesystem config.
